evidence_excerpts: For petrinet, an 8-byte data SPM reduces WCET to 82.5% and fitting all global data reaches 69.7%; for the real TriCore 40 kB SPM, average WCET reaches 79.8% of original WCET.
text: ILP-based data scratchpad allocation lowers WCET by moving frequently accessed variables into fast data scratchpad memory without changing generated code size.
